comment: Perfboard layout shown four ways (populated board, wiring diagram, underside, etched PCB); counted from the populated board. A BTDR-2 reverb module mounts to the solder side; the regulator is unlabelled on the board (pins I/G/O) and named 7805 on the wiring diagram.
uncertain: Regulator: labelled 7805 only on the wiring diagram, drawn in a TO-92 outline, so a 78L05 is probably intended
rows: reverb module, mounted to solder side
